policy: Fail closed. A previously recorded 0.45 EUR/kWh value for APCOA Neumarkt Leipzig is no longer exposed by the current official APCOA location page and therefore is not retained as active station-pricing evidence. The current APCOA pages confirm charging availability and, at several locations, ad-hoc QR/direct payment, but do not expose a reproducible current charging price in public HTML. Aggregator/eMSP prices are discovery-only and are not promoted to physical CPO pricing. Foreign APCOA tariffs are excluded.

supersededEvidence.reason: The current official APCOA charging/location page no longer publishes this charging price. Current page address metadata also differs from the earlier research snapshot. Keeping the old numeric value would violate fail-closed station-level verification.
